name: Chapter card — descent
description: Depth-stage deliverable for the chapter-card family (ADR-0028). The serif chapter title floats on the near plane over a cool slate photographic backdrop (atmosphere-slate substrate) 2.2 world units behind it; a slow dolly-in reprojects the two planes at different rates — the backdrop's light pools and bokeh give the parallax real features to track — while a rack focus pulls from the defocused backdrop onto the title as it mask-reveals: the card literally emerges into focus. The Pack's upper-left key light rakes both planes (the substrate's bloom sits upper-left to agree with it) and the type casts a soft real shadow onto the photo. Unlike chapter-card-cinematic (flat path, shader-implied camera), every depth cue here is geometric: real camera, real planes, real light. [Re-grounded 2026-07-09: depth stage + photographic atmosphere removed — the lens grammar is not the Syntax brand (same ruling as type-hero-vantage); flat warm-black field.]
